paragraphs: His son Chanina: Jerusalem Talmud Gittin, chapter 3, halakhah 8.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer Gittin3:8 scalar explicitly names Rav Assi bar Mamal as father of untitled Chinena (חיננא). Rav supports the heading expansion; the supplied body spells Chanina (חנינא), retained without an added son title.
